arguments.content:
# vLLM #49980 candidate: initialization-time capacity

Pre-size FlashInfer request and page metadata for the maximum chunked-local virtual-batch expansion derived from `max_model_len`, `attention_chunk_size`, `block_size`, and `max_num_seqs`. The ordinary non-local path is unchanged; no runtime allocations or pointer changes occur. Identical CPU regression covers the 34k-token/8192-chunk trigger (one physical request becomes five virtual batches and 2,560 padded pages).

Checks: Python 3.12 AST and bytecode compilation passed for both changed files. Pytest was attempted but unavailable because the pinned snapshot has no `.venv` and the host Python 3.12 environment lacks pytest. GPU/FlashInfer serving and CUDA-graph validation cannot run on this CPU host.

# vLLM #49980 candidate: guarded grow on demand

Grow FlashInfer request and page metadata only on overflow, using exact observed sizes. Refuse pointer replacement after any CUDA-graph decode wrapper has been created; chunked-local attention advertises no CUDA-graph support, so its long-prefill path may grow safely. The fit/common path adds only shape comparisons. Identical CPU regression covers the 34k-token/8192-chunk trigger (one physical request becomes five virtual batches and 2,560 padded pages).

Checks: Python 3.12 AST and bytecode compilation passed for both changed files. Pytest was attempted but unavailable because the pinned snapshot has no `.venv` and the host Python 3.12 environment lacks pytest. GPU/FlashInfer serving and CUDA-graph validation cannot run on this CPU host.

arguments.outcome: Initialization-capacity candidate rejected; guarded grow-on-demand selected for publication.
arguments.summary: For vLLM #49980, initialization-time sizing is correct and graph-stable but reserves request metadata for max_num_seqs multiplied by maximum local-attention chunk expansion. The guarded grow-on-demand design is preferable: allocate only on overflow, size to observed virtual requests/pages, and refuse pointer replacement after any CUDA-graph decode wrapper exists. ChunkedLocalAttention advertises AttentionCGSupport.NEVER, so the affected long-prefill path can grow without invalidating captured addresses. Preserve a CPU regression for the virtual-batch expansion trigger and require GPU serving plus graph-mode validation before upstreaming.
